crossRefs.note: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house, and sat at the table.
When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

translations.web: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in, and sat at the table.
translations.bsb: As Jesus was speaking, a Pharisee invited Him to dine with him; so He went in and reclined at the table.
translations.kjv: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
translations.asv: Now as he spake, a Pharisee asketh him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
